My interview with David Beckworth’s [Macro Musings podcast](https://macromusings.libsyn.com/stephen-kirchner-on-australian-monetary-policy-in-the-wake-of-the-great-recession) is now available. We talk inflation vs NGDP targeting, Australia’s recent macroeconomic history and what they put in the water at the BIS.
